verses.he: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אַ֤ךְ ט֭וֹב לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֱלֹהִ֗ים לְבָרֵ֥י לֵבָֽב׃
verses.en: A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, Even to such as are pure in heart.

verses.he: וַאֲנִ֗י כִּ֭מְעַט נטוי [נָטָ֣יוּ] רַגְלָ֑י כְּ֝אַ֗יִן שפכה [שֻׁפְּכ֥וּ] אֲשֻׁרָֽי׃
verses.en: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; My steps had well nigh slipped.

verses.he: כִּֽי־קִ֭נֵּאתִי בַּֽהוֹלְלִ֑ים שְׁל֖וֹם רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֶרְאֶֽה׃
verses.en: For I was envious at the arrogant, When I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

verses.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֖ין חַרְצֻבּ֥וֹת לְמוֹתָ֗ם וּבָרִ֥יא אוּלָֽם׃
verses.en: For there are no pangs at their death, And their body is sound.

verses.he: בַּעֲמַ֣ל אֱנ֣וֹשׁ אֵינֵ֑מוֹ וְעִם־אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א יְנֻגָּֽעוּ׃
verses.en: In the trouble of man they are not; Neither are they plagued like men.

verses.he: לָ֭כֵן עֲנָקַ֣תְמוֹ גַאֲוָ֑ה יַעֲטָף־שִׁ֝֗ית חָמָ֥ס לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: Therefore pride is as a chain about their neck; Violence covereth them as a garment.

verses.he: יָ֭צָא מֵחֵ֣לֶב עֵינֵ֑מוֹ עָ֝בְר֗וּ מַשְׂכִּיּ֥וֹת לֵבָֽב׃
verses.en: Their eyes stand forth from fatness; They are gone beyond the imaginations of their heart.

verses.he: יָמִ֤יקוּ׀ וִידַבְּר֣וּ בְרָ֣ע עֹ֑שֶׁק מִמָּר֥וֹם יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.en: They scoff, and in wickedness utter oppression; They speak as if there were none on high.

verses.he: שַׁתּ֣וּ בַשָּׁמַ֣יִם פִּיהֶ֑ם וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם תִּֽהֲלַ֥ךְ בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: They have set their mouth against the heavens, And their tongue walketh through the earth.

verses.he: לָכֵ֤ן׀ ישיב [יָשׁ֣וּב] עַמּ֣וֹ הֲלֹ֑ם וּמֵ֥י מָ֝לֵ֗א יִמָּ֥צוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: Therefore His people return hither; And waters of fullness are drained out by them.

verses.he: וְֽאָמְר֗וּ אֵיכָ֥ה יָדַֽע־אֵ֑ל וְיֵ֖שׁ דֵּעָ֣ה בְעֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.en: And they say: 'How doth God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?'

verses.he: הִנֵּה־אֵ֥לֶּה רְשָׁעִ֑ים וְשַׁלְוֵ֥י ע֝וֹלָ֗ם הִשְׂגּוּ־חָֽיִל׃
verses.en: Behold, such are the wicked; And they that are always at ease increase riches.

verses.he: אַךְ־רִ֭יק זִכִּ֣יתִי לְבָבִ֑י וָאֶרְחַ֖ץ בְּנִקָּי֣וֹן כַּפָּֽי׃
verses.en: Surely in vain have I cleansed my heart, And washed my hands in innocency;

verses.he: וָאֱהִ֣י נָ֭גוּעַ כָּל־הַיּ֑וֹם וְ֝תוֹכַחְתִּ֗י לַבְּקָרִֽים׃
verses.en: For all the day have I been plagued, And my chastisement came every morning.

verses.he: אִם־אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֲסַפְּרָ֥ה כְמ֑וֹ הִנֵּ֤ה ד֭וֹר בָּנֶ֣יךָ בָגָֽדְתִּי׃
verses.en: If I had said: 'I will speak thus', Behold, I had been faithless to the generation of Thy children.

verses.he: וָֽ֭אֲחַשְּׁבָה לָדַ֣עַת זֹ֑את עָמָ֖ל היא [ה֣וּא] בְעֵינָֽי׃
verses.en: And when I pondered how I might know this, It was wearisome in mine eyes;

verses.he: עַד־אָ֭בוֹא אֶל־מִקְדְּשֵׁי־אֵ֑ל אָ֝בִ֗ינָה לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם׃
verses.en: Until I entered into the sanctuary of God, And considered their end.

verses.he: אַ֣ךְ בַּ֭חֲלָקוֹת תָּשִׁ֣ית לָ֑מוֹ הִ֝פַּלְתָּ֗ם לְמַשּׁוּאֽוֹת׃
verses.en: Surely Thou settest them in slippery places; Thou hurlest them down to utter ruin.

verses.he: אֵ֤יךְ הָי֣וּ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה כְרָ֑גַע סָ֥פוּ תַ֝֗מּוּ מִן־בַּלָּהֽוֹת׃
verses.en: How are they become a desolation in a moment! They are wholly consumed by terrors.

verses.he: כַּחֲל֥וֹם מֵהָקִ֑יץ אֲ֝דֹנָי בָּעִ֤יר׀ צַלְמָ֬ם תִּבְזֶֽה׃
verses.en: As a dream when one awaketh, So, O Lord, when Thou arousest Thyself, Thou wilt despise their semblance.

verses.he: כִּ֭י יִתְחַמֵּ֣ץ לְבָבִ֑י וְ֝כִלְיוֹתַ֗י אֶשְׁתּוֹנָֽן׃
verses.en: For my heart was in a ferment, And I was pricked in my reins. .

verses.he: וַאֲנִי־בַ֭עַר וְלֹ֣א אֵדָ֑ע בְּ֝הֵמ֗וֹת הָיִ֥יתִי עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: But I was brutish, and ignorant; I was as a beast before Thee.

verses.he: וַאֲנִ֣י תָמִ֣יד עִמָּ֑ךְ אָ֝חַ֗זְתָּ בְּיַד־יְמִינִֽי׃
verses.en: Nevertheless I am continually with Thee; Thou holdest my right hand.

verses.he: בַּעֲצָתְךָ֥ תַנְחֵ֑נִי וְ֝אַחַ֗ר כָּב֥וֹד תִּקָּחֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Thou wilt guide me with Thy counsel, And afterward receive me with glory.

verses.he: מִי־לִ֥י בַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ֝עִמְּךָ֗ לֹא־חָפַ֥צְתִּי בָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Whom have I in heaven but Thee? And beside Thee I desire none upon earth.

verses.he: כָּלָ֥ה שְׁאֵרִ֗י וּלְבָ֫בִ֥י צוּר־לְבָבִ֥י וְחֶלְקִ֗י אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.en: My flesh and my heart faileth; But God is the rock of my heart and my portion for ever.

verses.he: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה רְחֵקֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ הִ֝צְמַ֗תָּה כָּל־זוֹנֶ֥ה מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.en: For, lo, they that go far from Thee shall perish; Thou dost destroy all them that go astray from Thee.

verses.he: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ קִֽרֲבַ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֗ים לִ֫י־ט֥וֹב שַׁתִּ֤י׀ בַּאדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י לְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר כָּל־מַלְאֲכוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: But as for me, the nearness of God is my good; I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, That I may tell of all Thy works.
